title: CARE: A Conformal Safety Layer for Medical Summarization
abstract: arXiv:2606.08969v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical summarization but can omit medically important information and introduce unsupported claims. Existing error-detection methods produce heuristic or uncalibrated scores, providing no formal control over missed errors and no principled way to trade off safety against clinician review burden. We introduce Conformal Assessment for Risk Evaluation (CARE), a post-hoc risk-control layer that adds calibrated omission and hallucination annotations without retraining the summarizer. CARE uses scalar conformal risk control (CRC) to bound the probability that a document contains an unflagged hallucinated sentence, and Learn-Then-Test fixed-sequence testing (LTT-FST) to control the expected fraction of true omissions left unsurfaced for review. translated_title: CARE：面向医学摘要生成的保形安全层
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于医学摘要生成，但它们可能遗漏医学上重要的信息，并引入缺乏依据的论断。现有的错误检测方法只能产生启发式或未经校准的分数，既无法对漏检错误提供形式化保证，也无法以原则性的方式在安全性与临床医生审阅负担之间进行权衡。我们提出了用于风险评估的保形评估方法（CARE），这是一种事后风险控制层，无需重新训练摘要模型即可添加经过校准的遗漏与幻觉标注。CARE 使用标量保形风险控制（CRC）来限定文档中存在未被标记的幻觉句子的概率，并使用“先学习后检验”固定序列检验（LTT-FST）来控制未被提交审阅的真实遗漏的期望比例。遗漏信息的呈现同时依赖于句子重要性和摘要覆盖率，这构成一个二维阈值选择问题；我们证明了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CARE 是一种无需重新训练模型的事后保形风险控制层，通过 CRC 与 LTT-FST 为医学摘要添加经过校准的遗漏与幻觉标注，在形式上控制漏检错误概率并平衡安全性与临床审阅负担。
en_tdlr: CARE is a post-hoc conformal risk-control layer that adds calibrated omission and hallucination annotations to medical summaries without retraining, using CRC and LTT-FST to provide formal guarantees against missed errors while balancing safety and clinician review burden.
